memories.content: They are responsible for the Apollo 11 program and must decide whether to publicly announce a go decision for the July launch window after the flight readiness review. They have access to technical assessments and schedules, but the outcome of the review is not yet determined.

The flight readiness review process for Apollo 11 is ongoing. A public announcement of a go decision for the July launch window would be made by senior managers after the review concludes. The review is expected to be completed before the end of June 1969.
